verdict.rationale: Deepgram ships an official `dg` CLI for transcription, live streaming, speech synthesis, text analysis and account management from the terminal [deepgram-docs-12, deepgram-probe-5]. It also includes a built-in MCP server that gives AI coding tools direct access to Deepgram APIs, which suits AI-native workflows [deepgram-docs-13, deepgram-docs-30]. missing for 10: evidence that the CLI covers Voice Agent-specific operations (e.g., managing reusable agent configurations or launching agent sessions), and independent or hands-on corroboration of CLI usage.
